extraction.text:
S. GANESH BALAAJI

AML/KYC Compliance | Financial Crime Compliance | Global KYC Operations Leadership

+91 9611320640 | balaji_ganesh86@yahoomail.com | linkedin.com/in/ganesh-balaji-aml-kyc | Kolkata PROFESSIONAL PROFILE

Results-driven Senior Programme Manager and AML/KYC Transformation leader with 17 years of experience delivering large-scale Client Lifecycle Management (CLM), Client Onboarding (OBKYC), regulatory remediation and business change initiatives across global Investment Banking organisations.

Extensive experience leading cross-functional transformation programmes across APAC, EMEA, UK and US, driving operational excellence, governance, control enhancements, workflow automation, risk reduction and stakeholder management. Proven track record of leading large teams, delivering strategic change, strengthening control frameworks and enabling cost optimisation.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Programme Management • Business Transformation • Business Change • Client Lifecycle Management (CLM) • Client Onboarding (OBKYC) • AML/KYC Compliance • CDD / EDD • Financial Crime Compliance • Regulatory Change • Control Automation • Workflow Automation • Programme Governance • Operational Risk & Controls • Cost Optimisation • Strategic Planning • Stakeholder Management • Executive Reporting • MIS & KRI Reporting • People Leadership

ACCOMPLISHMENTS

Led a cross-functional KYC transformation programme migrating the Periodic Review process from Singapore to Pune, improving operational efficiency while ensuring delivery governance and regulatory compliance.

Designed and implemented a centralized outreach model for Agent/Indirect Principal and same-group relationships, reducing review turnaround time by 5 days and improving client experience.

Partnered with Compliance, Front Office and Technology teams to implement workflow improvements and reliance-based review methodology, strengthening governance and operational efficiency.

Supported workforce optimisation initiatives contributing to 10% contractor-to-FTE conversion aligned with long-term business strategy and cost optimisation.

Enabled 60% FTE growth through structured governance, delivery excellence and stakeholder confidence.

Led transition and operational readiness of the Trade Confirmation process from a third-party vendor, ensuring successful stabilisation and governance.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Assistant Vice President, APAC, UK/US KYC Operations

Credit Suisse India Services Pvt. Ltd | Pune, India | Dec 2019 – Feb 2026

Led APAC Periodic Review operations managing 34+ FTEs across Private Banking and Institutional portfolios, driving programme governance, operational excellence and regulatory compliance.

Established risk-based review strategies reducing high-risk backlog through structured remediation, prioritisation and stakeholder engagement.

Led governance of adverse media reviews, regulatory escalations and financial crime risk assessments across high-risk client populations.

Implemented enhanced control frameworks across maker-checker-reviewer processes resulting in zero audit findings for three consecutive years.

Managed critical regulatory escalations, remediation workstreams and client risk reviews ensuring timely resolution.

Partnered with Technology, Compliance and Operations teams to deliver workflow automation and process enhancement initiatives.

Managed strategic KYC platform migration and operational readiness activities supporting business transformation.

Led post-merger integration covering governance, control stabilisation, operating model alignment and delivery milestones.



Team Manager, APAC KYC Operations

J.P. Morgan India Services Pvt. Ltd | Bangalore, India | Dec 2017 - Dec 2019

Managed APAC periodic review governance, ensuring adherence to regulatory deadlines, service-level expectations, quality standards, and operational risk controls.

Owned operational risk metrics, control reports, and management dashboards to support leadership oversight and timely risk intervention.

Drove remediation of aged and high-risk client populations through structured governance, prioritization, and stakeholder engagement.

Partnered with Front Office and Compliance teams to resolve documentation gaps, risk classification issues, and review closure dependencies.

Implemented population scoping and prioritization models to balance workload based on risk rating, regulatory urgency, and delivery timelines.

Team Leader, APAC + EMEA + US KYC Operations

State Street Global Advisors Pvt. Ltd | Bangalore, India	| Apr 2016 - Dec 2017

Defined and enforced a global governance model for KYC operations across APAC, EMEA, and US regions.

Managed 80+ FTEs and contractors across multiple shifts, ensuring delivery discipline, quality adherence, and operational stability.

Controlled operational risk through stakeholder governance, issue tracking, escalation management, and review closure oversight.

Stabilized the Alternative Investment Services KYC governance framework and improved review closure efficiency through structured monitoring and control routines.

Supported cross-regional coordination to manage workload allocation, delivery timelines, and process adherence across global teams.

Assistant Manager, Business Process Specialization & Consulting Accenture India Services Pvt. Ltd | Bangalore, India | Jul 2015 - Apr 2016

Built an end-to-end operating governance model for an Irish mortgage banking client.

Established risk-control documentation, KPI governance, resource-cost controls and training governance.

Supported budgeting and resource planning, including FTE calculation, cost tracking and capacity planning.

Process Supervisor, KYC - Client Onboarding



Deutsche Bank Group | Bangalore, India | Aug 2011 - Jul 2015

Supported premium clients end-to-end across due diligence, extensions, SSI setup and suspension workflows.

Identified and classified clients based on FATCA, Dodd-Frank, EMIR, Singapore Classification and HKPI requirements.

Analyst, Ops Data Management & KYC Operations WIPRO | Bangalore, India | Dec 2008 - Aug 2011

Conducted KYC due diligence for clients booked under UK and US jurisdictions.

Supported critical projects including Reporting Codes Mapping and data-management control activities.

SYSTEMS & TOOLS

Fenergo • World-Check • LexisNexis • Ripjar • KYC Workflow Tools • MS Excel • PowerPoint • MIS Reporting • KRI Dashboards • SharePoint

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS

Master of Business Administration (MBA), Finance | NMIMS | 2024

AML Transaction Monitoring & Suspicious Transaction Reporting | NISM | 2024

Bachelor of Business Management (BBM) | M.S. Ramaiah Degree College, Bangalore University | 2008
